source: Becca, 2026-10-13 (G320, P79) and 2026-10-15 (E67, V319, I162), selected in chat and recorded here verbatim; 2026-10-18 (Q187 replaces P79); 2026-10-18 late (F146 replaces Q187; after-162 corrected to after-161)
note: Hand-selected loop insertion sites that REPLACE deterministic-pipeline arms. Kept separate from tag_sites_loop_insertions.json, which is a verbatim record of pipeline output: attributing a selected site to the pipeline would misstate its provenance. The 2026-10-15 moves come from the tag-site model's ranked picks; its region bounds were checked against DeepTMHMM v1 on the designed CDS and agree to the residue on all five regions (MS4A1 79-84 and 142-188; SLC2A4 46-81, 309-322, 375-379), so the one-residue shifts off P66/G320/Y161 are genuinely adjacent residues and not a frame-convention difference. Room is quoted as residues available on each side of the junction within the extracellular run. Room is quoted N/C EXCLUSIVE of the junction residue; the first four sites were recorded inclusive and are corrected as of 2026-10-18.

MS4A1.verified: designed CDS 2026-10-15: residue 162 is I, next N, inside the 142-188 run and OUTSIDE the 167-183 disulfide
MS4A1.status: SUPERSEDED by Y161 -- same intended site, corrected by one residue.

MS4A1.selected_because: RETAINED DELIBERATELY AS THE FLOOR PROBE, NOT ENDORSED. The tag-site model does not offer this site at all: the 79-84 region is 6 aa against a 10-aa floor, and because MS4A1 has a viable region (142-188, 47 aa) the fallback never reaches the stub. Its distance to TM1 is 1 residue. Keeping it is what makes p0032 vs p0033 an experiment rather than a duplicate: the model separates the two as far as it can on one protein, so if P79 displays as well as I162 the length floor is wrong and that is a result about the gate, not about CD20. Do not read this entry as a recommendation.
MS4A1.verified: UniProt P11836 topology 2026-10-13: extracellular 79-84 between TM1 (57-78) and TM2 (85-105)
MS4A1.room_note: N side is ZERO: the 79-84 run starts at 79 and the junction is after 79, so no residue of the run lies N of it. This was recorded as 1 while the room convention was inclusive of the junction residue — the least honest possible number for a probe whose entire point is that there is nothing on that side. It is also what makes P79 an extreme rather than a representative floor test: the tag-location session measured a tight side of 1 as matching only 2.8% of 176 published internal sites, and 0 is tighter still, so a failure here indicts the extreme and not the 10-aa floor.
MS4A1.status: RETIRED 2026-10-18, replaced by Q187. Not built, not ordered.
MS4A1.retired_because: Becca took the model's rank-2 site instead. The MIN_LOOP_LEN floor is now unprobed by this batch: no arm inserts into a run shorter than 14 aa, so the 10-aa floor and the 51-aa cargo recalibration it needs stay open and must be answered elsewhere.

structure_gate_note: Topology is not sufficient to clear an internal site; secondary structure and 3D clearance are separate gates and they disqualified two sites topology had passed. Measured on AF-P11836-F1-model_v6, which matches the designed 297-aa proteoform residue-for-residue: residues 178-190 are a contiguous alpha-helical dihedral run at pLDDT 84-93, so 182 and 187 are in a HELIX, not a loop. Clearance to the nearest disulfide cysteine SG, junction by junction: after-146 16.0 A, after-161 11.9 A, after-162 8.3 A, after-182 7.4 A, after-187 5.6 A. Note 187 is outside the 167-183 disulfide SPAN and still 5.6 A from C167 in space, which is why a span test alone cleared it.
upstream_table_warning: The tag-sites pipeline still publishes MS4A1 N171 with the rationale '3D-clear of features' although N171 is inside the 167-183 disulfide. Their features.py treats a disulfide as two hazard POINTS vetoed by >=10 A distance, but the constraint for a disulfide is ENCLOSURE, not distance, so a residue topologically inside the closed loop passes when it is far enough away in space. Reported by that session 2026-10-18 across 24,018 published internal deterministic sites over 2,413 genes. Treat any site inside a disulfide span in that table as unvalidated until the gate is fixed. Our retirement of N171 was independently correct.
